Title: Draft 2: An open-source project for developers building apps on Kubernetes

Body.Content:
Announcing Draft 2, a new version of the open-source project that makes it easier for developers to build applications that run on Kubernetes. Draft was created for developers. Using Draft, developers can create a Dockerfile, Kubernetes manifests, Helm chart, or Kustomize configurations for their application. Draft can also generate a GitHub Action workflow file to easily build and deploy applications onto any Kubernetes cluster.

Learn more.
